consequence.statement: If the legacy metrics are in use (ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS=true), monitoring dashboards and alerts must be updated to use argocd_app_info labels before upgrading, since the old metrics are removed.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards and alerts to use the labels on argocd_app_info before upgrading.

original.statement: The legacy metrics argocd_app_sync_status, argocd_app_health_status and argocd_app_created_time are removed in 3.0.0; use labels on argocd_app_info instead, which matters if ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS is set to true.

decision.reason: [ev-06e920b4a3dd] says the three legacy metrics, which are only emitted when ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS is explicitly true, have been removed. Its Migration section says users of these metrics "will need to update your monitoring dashboards and alerts to use the new metric and labels before upgrading". A required step before the upgrade matches migration-required, which falls in the action class. The proposed statement and remediation repeat the evidence's wording without adding anything, and medium severity is reasonable for a monitoring-only effect.
